summary: BI-EF265C9A (slice 4 of EP-PORTFOLIO-BUDGET-WIP). New model BudgetReservation and enum BudgetReservationState (reserved|consumed|released): the investment points a funding approval reserves against a portfolio's quarterly budget. Written by approve_demand_for_funding after a funded decision; settled by settleBudgetReservations (done consumes, retired or deferred releases, a re-size adjusts the points and records a budget_reservation_resized activity), which the status tools call at once and a 15-minute cron sweeps. One open reservation per item (partial unique index). Additive: a new empty table, no backfill. Migration: 20260925200000_budget_reservation.

fields.name: backlogItemId
fields.reason: The funded item; cascades with it.

fields.name: portfolioId
fields.reason: The portfolio whose budget carries the points, resolved by the slice 1 attribution.

fields.name: periodStart
fields.reason: The UTC quarter the reservation counts against.

fields.name: points
fields.reason: The item's investment points; adjusted on re-size with an activity row.

fields.name: state
fields.reason: reserved, consumed or released, derived from the item's status.

fields.name: overrideReason
fields.reason: A person's reason for approving past the allocation; an autonomous caller is refused instead.

fields.name: actorId
fields.reason: The person who approved the funding.

fields.name: actorAgentId

fields.name: settledAt
fields.reason: When the reservation was consumed or released.
